newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI bars Global Finance from new schemes.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI bars Global Finance from new schemes.

text.p: Market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on Thursday said it prohibited Global Finance Corporation Ltd from launching its proposed mutual funds.
SEBI said its action follows Reserve Bank of India's recent ban on Global Finance from accepting deposits in view of various irregularities and violations of procedures.
The company will also not be allowed to function as a registrar and share transfer agent, SEBI said.
